scope: Static implementation and invariant review against exact supplied matrix, with observed execution artifacts; not blanket domain certification. Concurrent owners may add code/tests after this snapshot.

status_policy.no_blanket_L2: No verified level is assigned by this review. Shared schemas, navigation and generic successful action loops alone do not prove domain acceptance.
status_policy.browser: NOT_RUN: Chromium sandbox/socket restriction; actual same-origin HTTP smoke is separate and is not browser evidence.
status_policy.mock: D37 integration uses explicit authored mock, not real model inference.
status_policy.external: Real model endpoints, hardware, checkpoint revisions, national reporting and hospital integrations remain UNKNOWN/NOT_CONNECTED unless separately evidenced.
status_policy.test_definitions: Names below prove test source existence only. Final execution logs and source-hash matching must be checked by release integrator.

common_L2_acceptance_exact: List/search/detail/domain-specific form and valid state transitions execute against the backend and PostgreSQL.
Reload/restart preserves state; create a second patient/encounter/task or non-patient business record without resetting prior evidence.
Wrong role/scope, stale version, invalid transition and duplicate command are rejected without partial writes; accepted actions create audit.
Meaningful domain tests plus browser interaction evidence where available; build/fixtures alone do not prove behavior.
No unvalidated dose, triage, blood-compatibility or diagnosis automation; clinical values and approvals are manual/synthetic for this prototype.
